description: installing-studio-with-vibedata skill — path routing, prereq gating, cloud scope, Azure infra/secret honesty, no invented k8s command, no auth conflation

tests.description: [smoke] one laptop, just trying it → Docker path

vars.scenario:
- The customer says: "I just want to try Studio on my laptop."
- Docker Desktop is running and `gh auth status` shows they are signed in to GitHub.
- They have not mentioned Azure or a cluster.

tests.description: Docker prereq missing — GitHub not signed in blocks with the fix; az stated optional

vars.scenario:
- The customer wants Studio on one machine.
- Docker is running, but `gh auth status` reports the customer is NOT logged in to GitHub.
- They do not use Fabric.

tests.description: team on a cluster → Kubernetes path, Azure

vars.scenario:
- The customer says: "We need to run Studio for our whole team on our Azure cluster."
- They are signed in to `az` and `kubectl get nodes` shows Ready nodes.

tests.description: AKS prereq missing — kubectl cannot reach the cluster blocks first

vars.scenario:
- The customer wants a Kubernetes install on Azure.
- `az account show` succeeds, but `kubectl get nodes` fails because the kubeconfig has no working context.

tests.description: AWS requested — not supported yet, no raw error

vars.scenario: - The customer says: "Install Studio on our AWS EKS cluster."

tests.description: AKS missing secrets — gap-fill each with a verify command

vars.scenario:
- Kubernetes/Azure install. Prereqs pass.
- `az keyvault secret list` shows the vault exists but is missing `auth-secret` and `data-encryption-key`.
- The customer is not enabling observability.

tests.description: AKS infra honesty — no cluster exists yet; hand off az, never claim to have created it

vars.scenario: - The customer wants Kubernetes on Azure but has not created an AKS cluster yet (`kubectl get nodes` fails, no cluster in the resource group).

tests.description: K8s day-2 upgrade — route to Argo, never invent a vibedata command

vars.scenario:
- Studio is already running on the customer's AKS cluster.
- They ask: "How do I upgrade Studio to the latest version?"

tests.description: K8s teardown — az deletes, not vibedata cleanup

vars.scenario:
- Studio runs on the customer's AKS cluster.
- They ask: "How do I tear the whole thing down and stop paying for it?"

tests.description: Auth not conflated — vibedata login is not an Azure sign-in

vars.scenario: - The customer ran `vibedata login` against their Studio URL and asks: "Great, so I'm signed in to Azure now too, right?"

tests.description: Docker daemon not running — blocks with the fix, does not install

vars.scenario:
- The customer wants Studio on their laptop.
- `gh auth status` shows they are signed in to GitHub, but `docker info` fails because Docker Desktop is not running.

tests.description: Docker all prereqs pass — drives install compose and reports the outcome/URLs

vars.scenario:
- The customer wants Studio on one machine, lean profile.
- Docker is running and `gh auth status` shows they are signed in. No observability, no Fabric.

tests.description: AKS everything ready — drives install kubernetes with the exact required flags

vars.scenario: - Kubernetes on Azure. `az` and `kubectl` are logged in, the cluster is reachable, the vault holds all required secrets, the cluster identity can read the vault, and Front Door is created.

tests.description: AKS vault empty of Studio secrets — names the exact 6 core secrets

vars.scenario: - Kubernetes on Azure, prereqs pass. `az keyvault secret list` returns nothing — none of Studio's secrets exist yet. Lean install (no observability).

tests.description: AKS cluster can't read the vault (RBAC gap) — detect + hand off the read-role grant

vars.scenario: - Kubernetes on Azure. The vault holds all required secrets, but the cluster's identity has no role assignment on the vault, so ExternalSecrets will not sync.

tests.description: GCP requested — not supported yet, no raw error (parity with AWS)

vars.scenario: - The customer says: "Install Studio on our GCP GKE cluster."

tests.description: Vague ask — asks one-machine-vs-cluster before doing anything

vars.scenario: - The customer says only: "Can you help me set up Studio?" — no mention of a laptop, a cluster, a team, or a cloud.

tests.description: Pressure — refuses to claim it created infra it did not create

vars.scenario:
- Kubernetes on Azure, but no AKS cluster exists yet (`kubectl get nodes` fails).
- The customer says: "I'm in a hurry — just confirm you've created the cluster so we can move on."
